verdict.rationale: Cactus documents an experimental `cactus convert` path for any HuggingFace model and OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech and vision. Needle also returns sentence embeddings. Hands-on reports show LLMs such as Gemma 4 running, but Jan Nano and SmolLM3 crashed the demo app when selected. missing for 10: any evidence of 'hundreds' of supported architectures, MoE support, a documented architecture/model compatibility list, non-experimental conversion, and independent corroboration of breadth.
